questions.question: What do shut-off valves do?

options.text: Stop air from leaving the air brake system.
Stop air from entering the air brake system.
Control vehicles that are out of control.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop air from leaving the air brake system.
questions.explanation: Shut-off valves control air flow between trailers. The rear shut-off valve must stay closed to prevent air from leaving the brake system.

questions.question: Which trailer is most likely to roll over during a quick turn?
questions.correctAnswerText: Last
questions.explanation: Quick turns are dangerous when pulling trailers. The last trailer is most likely to roll over if you turn too fast.

questions.question: When hooking a converter dolly to a second trailer, the trailer height should be ____ the fifth wheel center.
questions.correctAnswerText: Slightly lower than
questions.explanation: When connecting a converter dolly to a second or third trailer, the trailer should be slightly lower than the fifth wheel center.

questions.question: What happens if the emergency air line loses pressure?

options.text: The Anti-Lock Braking System will turn on.
The service air line will turn on.
The emergency brakes will turn on.

questions.correctAnswerText: The emergency brakes will turn on.
questions.explanation: The emergency air line controls the emergency brakes. If air pressure is lost in this line, the emergency brakes will activate.

questions.question: If a trailer starts to jackknife, what should the driver do?

options.text: Should not use the trailer hand brake.
Can straighten the trailer with the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should not use the trailer hand brake.
questions.explanation: If a trailer jackknifes, release the brakes to let the wheels grip the road again. Do not use the trailer hand brake because braking is what caused the wheels to lock.

questions.question: When should you use a trailer hand valve?

options.text: Only to test the trailer brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to test the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: The trailer hand valve should only be used to test the brakes. Using it while driving can cause a skid. Do not use it while parking because it may release the brakes holding the vehicle.

questions.question: How should you brake when your vehicle has ABS?

options.text: Push the brake pedal harder than normal.
Push the brake pedal as you normally would.
Push the brake pedal lighter than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Push the brake pedal as you normally would.
questions.explanation: With ABS, apply the brakes the same way you would without it.

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: It lets the wheels lock up.
It stops the wheels from locking up.

questions.correctAnswerText: It stops the wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: ABS prevents the wheels from locking during hard braking. It reduces braking pressure if lockup is detected.

questions.question: Why should you not use the trailer hand valve while driving?

options.text: It will disconnect from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can cause a skid.
questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve while driving. It can cause your trailer to skid.

questions.question: What is one benefit of keeping cargo low?
questions.correctAnswerText: It helps prevent a rollover.
questions.explanation: Keep cargo low to lower the vehicle's center of gravity. This helps prevent rollovers during quick turns.

questions.question: A trailer that is too high:
questions.correctAnswerText: May not connect properly.
questions.explanation: Before connecting a tractor to a trailer, check that the trailer is at the right height. A trailer that is too low can damage the trailer nose. A trailer that is too high may not connect properly.

questions.question: Having anti-lock brakes on only one axle:

options.text: Will give you better control when braking.
Will likely break the air brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will give you better control when braking.
questions.explanation: Anti-lock brakes on one axle still help. You will have more control when braking than if you had no anti-lock brakes at all.

questions.question: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air supply leaks away:

options.text: The trailer will have no brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer will have no brakes.
questions.explanation: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air leaks out, there will be no working brakes. The wheels will spin freely.

questions.question: What is a bobtail tractor?

options.text: A tractor with no trailer attached
A tractor with two trailers attached
A tractor that goes faster than the speed limit

questions.correctAnswerText: A tractor with no trailer attached
questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor with no trailer. Bobtail tractors are hard to operate and require extra caution.

questions.question: More than half of all truck driver deaths from accidents are caused by:
questions.correctAnswerText: Rollovers.
questions.explanation: Truck rollovers cause more than half of all accident-related truck driver deaths. To prevent rollovers, keep cargo low and centered. Take corners slowly and carefully.

questions.question: Bobtail tractors are ____ to stop than tractors with full trailers.
questions.correctAnswerText: More difficult
questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is harder to stop than a tractor with a loaded trailer. It takes longer to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: If you use the trailer hand brake while your trailer is skidding, it will:
questions.correctAnswerText: Make the skid worse.
questions.explanation: During a skid, release the brakes to help your tires regain grip. Using the trailer hand brake while skidding will only make the skid worse.

questions.question: If the emergency air line loses pressure:

options.text: The tractor protection valve will close.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tractor protection valve will close.
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve protects the trailer brakes if the trailer breaks away or develops a leak. When air pressure is lost in the emergency line, the valve closes and the emergency trailer brakes activate.

questions.question: When backing your tractor under a trailer to connect it, the trailer brakes should be:
questions.correctAnswerText: Locked.
questions.explanation: Always lock the trailer brakes before backing your tractor under the trailer during coupling. This is an important safety step.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: To check the connection between trailer and tractor.

questions.correctAnswerText: To test the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: The trailer hand valve operates the trailer brakes and should only be used for testing them. Using it while driving can cause a skid.
